steps.bass: A common way to play with both hands: the right hand plays the melody while the left hand holds long bass notes underneath. Here the left hand only needs {c3} (little finger) and {g3} (thumb).
steps.auClair: “Au clair de la lune” with a bass line. The left hand changes key only every few beats: hold each note while the right hand moves.
steps.auClairInTime: Now in time with the metronome.
steps.odeToJoy: “Ode to Joy” with both hands. The bass notes come on the first beat of some bars.
